title: Smooth homotopy estimate |X(G^#ω) − X(F^#ω)| ≤ δ(Λ^k M(X)‖dω‖ + Λ^{k−1} M(∂X)‖ω‖) for normal currents with compact support
statement: Assume (VO), the vanishing-off-support antecedent: for all P, n, U, S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n) and ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with tsupport ω disjoint from spt S, S(ω) = 0; (REP), the mass-representation antecedent: for U open and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with M_W(T) < ∞ for every open W ⊂⊂ U there are a measure μ (μ(Uᶜ) = 0, finite on compact subsets of U) and ξ : ℝ^P → MultiVector P n (μ-a.e. strongly measurable, |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for all x, α) with M_W(T) = μ(W) for every open W, T(ω) = ∫ ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ for all ω, and, if also M_W(∂T) < ∞ for open W ⊂⊂ U, μ(E) = 0 whenever Hⁿ(E) = 0; and (LB), the covector-bounds antecedent (exactly the frozen type of the parent's covector-bounds dependency): (L1) |β.compContinuousLinearMap A| ≤ ‖A‖^k·|β| for every continuous linear A : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} and k-covector β on ℝ^{N'}; (L2) |β.curryLeft v| ≤ ‖v‖·|β| for v ∈ ℝ^N and every (k+1)-covector β on ℝ^N; (L3) |α(τ)| ≤ |α| for orthonormal τ (exact frozen Lean types, written as antecedents). For all N, N', k ∈ ℕ, reals Λ, δ, a, b, C^∞ maps F, G : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'}, X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) with compact support, M(X) < ∞ and boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞, ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^{N'}) and η_F, η_G ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N): if ‖DF(x)‖ ≤ Λ and ‖DG(x)‖ ≤ Λ for x ∈ spt X, |F(x) − G(x)| ≤ δ for x ∈ spt X, |ω(y)| ≤ a and |dω(y)| ≤ b for all y, and η_F = F^#ω, η_G = G^#ω on open sets containing spt X (F^#ω(x) := (ω(F x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ F x)), then |X(η_G) − X(η_F)| ≤ δ·(Λ^k·M(X)·b + Λ^{k−1}·M_∂·a), where M(X) and M_∂ := boundaryMassOn X univ (= M(∂X) for k ≥ 1, 0 for k = 0) are taken as reals via ENNReal.toReal and k − 1 is truncated subtraction.
